goal: A Story delivery run persists checkpoints, survives interrupt and a replaced execution environment, and resumes without losing accepted decisions or repeating completed steps
scenarios: developer starts one Story delivery run after Definition of Ready
the run records a durable checkpoint after each accepted step
interrupt then resume on a new runtime continues from the checkpoint
duplicate or stale events do not advance the run
cancel or retry limits stop the run with a visible reason
constraints: dsh owns session storage; HuntianLing owns delivery records
